skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can explain money theories and their practical applications.
Students can analyze the impact of monetary policies on macroeconomic variables.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate monetary policy effectiveness.
Ability to conduct independent research and work in teams.
Effective presentation and communication of research findings.
Capacity for self-directed learning and continuous improvement.
Collaborative work and responsibility in group activities.
Constructive argumentation and debate on monetary policy issues.
Ability to independently study and research monetary economics topics.
